justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/javacc-support/com/github/javaparser/GeneratedJavaParserBase.java` (450 lines, ~26 methods) and `javaparser-core/src/main/javacc/java.jj`. The class mixes several separable responsibilities in one abstract base: parser/token state and reset (`reset`, `setStoreTokens`, `getTokens`), token-range construction helpers (`range`, `tokenRange`, `orIfInvalid`, `nodeListBegin`), parse recovery/error reporting (`recover`, `recoverStatement`, `makeMessageForParseException`), AST/list construction helpers (`add`, `prepend`, `generateLambda`, `juggleArrayCreation`, `juggleArrayType`), and name/string utilities (`scopeToName`, `unquote`, `unTripleQuote`). The grammar file calls these helpers from unrelated productions, confirming the class acts as a kitchen-sink parser support class rather than a narrowly focused abstraction.
